title: Lipid flip-flop in biological membranes: through the lens of TMEM16F

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Lipid flip-flop in biological membranes: through the lens of TMEM16F》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】The asymmetric distribution of phospholipids between membrane leaflets is a hallmark of all known cells, yet many fundamental questions about membrane lipid asymmetry remain unanswered.
